Header banner for the Brightening & Glow COLLECTION.

NOT THE PAGE. /pages/brightening-glow already has a hero built from the gpt_image version of this same pose. Malcolm's URL was the collection, which had no dedicated banner and was sitting on the shared default template. Both now exist, from different engines' takes on the same shot — filenames are deliberately far apart so Shopify's suffix-on-collision behaviour cannot serve one in place of the other.

EXTENDS LEFT, opposite to the page entry, because a different engine's frame has different edges. Measured: the RIGHT edge carries her neck and shoulder from row 264 to the bottom (mean 119.6, max 194.6) — nothing to sample. The LEFT edge is clean end to end at 18.1–24.0 with nothing above 45 anywhere. Same pose, same product, opposite treatment; the edge decides, not the pose name.

THE CONCENTRATION FAULT IS FIXED. The library frame printed '25i GLUTATHIONE | 30ML' where the product is 2% — sub-legible at banner size (about 4px of cap height) but a wrong concentration on a skincare product, so it was repaired rather than tolerated. glut-a-bottle-text-fix.json ran the repair across all four suppliers; Malcolm chose gpt_image_02. Verified at 100%: '2% GLUTATHIONE | 30ML' with all six label elements clean.

HE CHOSE IT OVER LOWER-DRIFT CANDIDATES, which is worth recording: nbp_flash_02 measured 3.85 composition drift against this one's 8.57. Inspected rather than assumed — the difference is tonal plus a slightly different native crop (2.415:1 against the library frame's 2.357:1), not a restage. Pose, face, hand and bottle all hold. Seedream's two were the worst on both axes: 11.02 and 11.99 drift, and seedream_01 printed GLUTNHIDE for GLUTATHIONE.

EVERY MEASUREMENT BELOW WAS RE-TAKEN for this render rather than carried over. Its left edge runs 14.8-21.8 with nothing above 45, but the clean texture box is SHALLOWER than the library frame's: rows 0-400 cols 0-120 reads max 25, while the full-height version of the same box reads 192, because her fingers sit higher in this crop. Extension is 1702px rather than 1751px.

texture_box stops at x=120 because her fingers reach x=65 in the lower rows and the boxes one step wider read max 173–185 against this one's 27. Scatter rather than tile, per the serums banner. Residual banding 1.72 levels on a background of 20.2 — the cleanest extension of the session.

Heading ground after extension: 336px at 1280, 496px at 1440, 975px at 1920.

OPTIMISATION AND SEO NAMING, both MEASURED rather than assumed (Malcolm's standing instruction, 2026-08-24).

DELIVERY WAS ALREADY RIGHT and is left alone. The theme emits fetchpriority="high" on this img — it is the LCP element — plus sizes=100vw, a 19-step srcset from 200 to 3000, explicit width/height so there is no layout shift, no loading="lazy" (which would hurt an LCP image), and a separate <source> for phones with its own srcset. Measured off the live CDN: 41.8KB at width=1280, 54.9KB at 1500, 83.6KB at 1920, 136.9KB at 3000; the phone file is 45.6KB at 600. The uploader caps the master at 3000px, exactly the srcset ceiling, so no dead weight ships.

NOT RE-COMPRESSED, deliberately. Rule 5 records that dropping JPEG quality before upload made this store marginally SLOWER: the CDN transcodes to WebP and resizes per srcset, so the source is never what a visitor downloads, and handing the encoder a picture full of JPEG artefacts costs bits to reproduce. Quality stays 95 at 4:4:4 with metadata stripped.

FILENAMES CHANGED, because the previous pair was flagged. '...-serum-2-percent' trips the bare-digit rule — a lone '2' carries no search value in an image search. The new pair leads with what a shopper types for this page (glutathione, serum, brightening, glow) and ends on hyperpigmentation, the concern the collection's own description names. Both pass check_seo_name clean at 64 and 53 characters.

And neither stem prefixes the other, which is the cheap guard against the bug found the same hour: '...-2-percent' prefixed '...-2-percent-mobile' and bound both slots to the phone crop.
